+  defp decode!(json_text) do
+    decoders = [
+      object_finish: fn acc, old_acc -> {{:object, Enum.reverse(acc)}, old_acc} end
+    ]
+
+    case JSON.decode(json_text, :ok, decoders) do
+      {decoded, :ok, ""} ->
+        decoded
+
+      {:error, {:unexpected_end, offset}} ->
+        raise JSON.DecodeError,
+          message: "unexpected end of JSON binary at position (byte offset) #{offset}",
+          data: json_text,
+          offset: offset
+
+      {:error, {:invalid_byte, offset, byte}} ->
+        raise JSON.DecodeError,
+          message: "invalid byte #{byte} at position (byte offset) #{offset}",
+          data: json_text,
+          offset: offset
+
+      {:error, {:unexpected_sequence, offset, bytes}} ->
+        raise JSON.DecodeError,
+          message: "unexpected sequence #{inspect(bytes)} at position (byte offset) #{offset}",
+          data: json_text,
+          offset: offset
+
+      {_, :ok, rest} ->
+        raise JSON.DecodeError,
+          message: "unexpected trailing content",
+          data: json_text,
+          offset: byte_size(json_text) - byte_size(rest)
+    end
+  end
+
